note: The unit here is the VOLUME, not the page. Every page of a declared volume was cropped, laid out and walked; the cards kept are the ones whose body names Chicago, Cook County or Illinois, and the rest are read and not kept. Declaring the pages would be a lie in the other direction — it would report a hole on every page that carries no Illinois family, and there are hundreds of them.

declarations.note: Volume 1 (A-C), Internet Archive file FL2091539_CP-130151_01.pdf, 987 pages, read by its text layer in four cropped column passes. 58,488 cards assembled; 2,579 kept for naming Chicago, Cook County or Illinois; 581 of those name Chicago or Cook County.

Volume 2 (C-H), Internet Archive file FL2091536_CP-130151_02.pdf, 1,016 pages, read by its text layer in the same four cropped column passes. 58,589 cards assembled; 1,987 kept for naming Chicago, Cook County or Illinois; 501 of those name Chicago or Cook County. Forty were drawn and adjudicated against the page image at 0.875 precision — 20 of 20 in the Chicago-and-Cook stratum, 15 of 20 in the Illinois-only one; the five bad keeps are two classes, and T-0600 carries the rules that would strike them. T-0601 carries the column-sliver double count the same draw found.
